name: gainable
description: Build and change Gainable apps from Codex. Registers the Gainable MCP connector, bundles the gainable skill, and orients each session on the project the folder belongs to.

interface.shortDescription: Build & change Gainable apps from Codex
interface.longDescription: Drive Gainable from Codex: build a new app from an idea or a spreadsheet, change one that already exists, publish it, and manage who can use it. The work happens server-side through the Gainable MCP connector — there is no local codebase to edit. This plugin registers that connector, and supplies the steering: which tool to reach for, how to relay the connector's questions back to you unanswered, and which Gainable project the current folder belongs to.
defaultPrompt: Build a CRM app for tracking SaaS deals with Gainable.
Add KPI cards to the sponsors view.
